review_basis: The second entry off opentakeoff-corpus/reports/LINEAR_HELDOUT.txt's frozen list (itd-d1-lab-mechanical.pdf#4, pinned there by the plan verbatim). Candidates found via a grid-sweep of trace_run seeds across this sheet's own duct size labels (8"/10"/12"/14"/26"/34" round, several rectangular transitions) -- a first promising hit (3.11 LF, round:8, both stops 'dead_end') was VISUALLY REJECTED before being trusted: a marked render crop showed its two endpoints sat on a wall/shaft outline and a text-leader stub, not real ductwork at all -- confidence:0 and factors ['stroke-family:unclassified','layer-unclassified'] had already flagged it as suspect, and the crop confirmed the suspicion rather than overriding it. This is disclosed because a same-checkpoint discipline reminder: visually verify before trusting, exactly as this corpus's own prior findings (the two coordinate bugs in Run 3, Finding 5's own disproven hypothesis) already established. A second candidate (seed 1569,858 -> 3.02 LF, round:8) was verified instead: a marked render crop confirms a real double-line 8"Ø round duct running horizontally from a genuine wall-penetration dead end to a real elbow/damper assembly (the walker's own 'family_change' stop at the wall end and 'ambiguous' stop at the elbow/damper end both correspond to real drawn CAD features, not narrative choices) -- this run ALSO reads confidence:0 / stroke-family:unclassified (unlike weld-county's layer-name read or federal-p7's pen-weight-prior read), a third, lower-confidence code path worth having in the held-out set on its own merits, not despite the low score. System code: no explicit SA/RA/EA tag sits on this run. Recorded as 'EA' (exhaust air) from disclosed circumstantial evidence, not a directly-read label: this sheet's own keynote list is dominated by exhaust-ductwork routing notes ('ROUTE 8" DUCT DOWN TO SNORKEL HOOD', 'ROUTE EXHAUST DUCTWORK MAINS TIGHT TO STRUCTURE') for what is evidently a lab building with fume hoods and cooking-equipment exhaust (snorkel hoods, an oven flue) -- consistent with an 8" branch feeding a hood connection -- and an unresolved equipment tag 'SEV' sits immediately beside this run's own far end, plausibly a hood-connection tag though its expansion could not be confirmed from extractable text. sheet_title is recorded as null rather than guessed: unlike itd-d1-lab-m1-2.json's own 'HYDRONIC FLOOR PLAN' (found in a title-block-shaped text run), no equivalent title text could be found anywhere on this sheet after several targeted searches -- this Revit-exported sheet may render its view title as a non-text graphic, or place it somewhere this pass's searches didn't check; left honestly blank rather than invented.

This run is an 8" round duct segment on a dense ductwork sheet (itd-d1-lab-mechanical.pdf, page 4, sheet M1.1 -- the SAME source PDF as the existing hydronic development-tier golden itd-d1-lab-m1-2.json, but a DIFFERENT page/sheet, so this remains a genuine held-out measurement: page 5 was traced during development, page 4 was not), from a real wall-penetration dead end to a real elbow/damper junction.
